name: Consortium in the Coastal Lowlands
excerpt: A consortium believed to have an interest in Admiralty patrol routes.
notes:
- The consortium is believed to operate in the coastal lowlands.
- Allegedly received altered survey data to influence Admiralty patrol routes.
- The complaint against Harwick Ossel involved this consortium.
